items.title: US says Iran seeking 'exit ramp' despite mixed ceasefire signals
items.description: The White House says talks with Iran aimed at ending the conflict have not stalled, despite conflicting reports on Iran's response to a 15-point ceasefire proposal.

items.title: Meta and Google found liable in landmark social media addiction lawsuit
items.description: The lawsuit, which saw tech companies accused of causing harm by deliberately designing addictive platforms, could influence the outcome of thousands of other cases.

items.title: The on-again, off-again negotiations are on — for now. What you need to know today
items.description: Both the Trump administration and the Iranian regime have their own unique ways of expressing themselves — and both are prone to hyperbole, says Mark Doran in Beirut.

items.title: Oil price spikes are driving a surge of interest in electric vehicles
items.description: The clear signal this trend data sends is that Australians are a pragmatic lot. If using an EV might save them money, then they are interested.

items.title: Kyle Sandilands is rich and driven to win. But the stakes of suing ARN are high
items.description: There's an $88 million question doing the rounds of legal and media circles, after the catastrophic falling-out between radio shock jocks Kyle and Jackie O and their former radio network ARN.

items.title: We've been here before as global crises tend to follow a predictable path
items.description: If the mass uncertainty sparked by the military escalation in Iran is making you feel anxious, you are not alone — but there is some calming news for us all.

items.title: Former Brisbane Lion Leigh Ryswyk becomes first openly gay AFL player
items.description: Former Brisbane Lions player Leigh Ryswyk has become the first openly gay AFL player, past or present.

items.title: Savannah Guthrie gives first interview since mother's disappearance
items.description: It is the Today show host's first interview since her mother Nancy was reported missing from her Arizona home on February 1.

items.title: 'Fight will continue' without change, say ABC workers amid 24-hour strike
items.description: Unions representing ABC staff have signalled the possibility of further strike action if a dispute over pay and conditions at the broadcaster isn't resolved.

items.title: Man dubbed 'miracle baby' when he was born dies aged 33
items.description: Ryan Bowman fought through congenital heart defects and cancer, but his family says his final hospital visit led to some frightening final hours.

items.title: The Gold Coast has transformed over 50 years. Its growth debate hasn't
items.description: Fifty years after fears it would be a "concrete jungle" first surfaced, the Gold Coast is again grappling with the same question: how to grow without losing its identity.

items.title: Summer cyclone and winter storm as Australia's weather turns unseasonal
items.description: A clash of seasons is developing on Australia's weather map this week as a tropical cyclone tracks towards the WA west coast and a cold polar blast with thunderstorms forms over the east.

items.title: How do you make friends in the country if you don't play sport?
items.description: From crafting to surfing, people of all ages are experimenting with new hobbies to meet pals in regional Victoria.

items.title: ABC Shakespeare quiz, parteth the seceund: Test thine knowledge once more
items.description: Is this a quiz which you see before you?  We're back with another 10 questions to test your knowledge of William Shakespeare's plays.

items.title: How the 'Mind' diet could help keep your brain sharp as you age
items.description: The food choices we make over decades — not just in later life, but across adulthood — may quietly shape the health of our brains in ways that only become visible much later.

items.title: Bondi hero Ahmed Al Ahmed awarded key to city for bravery in terror attack
items.description: Father-of-two Ahmed Al Ahmed has been awarded a key to the city and a lifetime beach parking pass for his bravery in disarming one of the Bondi shooters during the December 14 terror attack.

items.title: UK police arrest two men over arson attack on ambulances in London
items.description: British police arrest two men in connection with an arson attack on four ambulances belonging to a Jewish charity, which authorities are investigating as an antisemitic hate crime.

items.title: 'Major player' charged over Sydney grandfather's alleged kidnapping murder
items.description: Police allege the 23-year-old man was a "major player" in organising the abduction plot.

items.title: The numbers behind Queensland's claim to be the AFL's second home
items.description: The question of who loves footy the most has sparked countless hours of debate over the past century, and Queensland is staking a major claim.

items.title: Meta ordered to pay $538m in US trial over child exploitation claims
items.description: The verdict marks the first time a jury has ruled on such claims against Meta, as the company faces a wave of lawsuits over how its platforms affect young people's mental health.

items.title: Title beckons as South Australia peak for Sheffield Shield final
items.description: Victory in this year's Sheffield Shield final over Victoria will be especially sweet for South Australia, with coach Ryan Harris saying their path to the title decider this time around has been challenging.

items.title: Russia fires nearly 400 drones at Ukraine with signs its spring offensive has begun
items.description: Russia's anticipated annual spring offensive appears to have started, with a major drone assault on civilian areas coinciding with multiple attempts to break through frontline Ukrainian defences.

items.title: 25yo Indigenous man dies in NT police custody after detainment in car cage
items.description: A 25-year-old Indigenous man has died in police custody in Darwin's northern suburbs overnight, with police saying he was "arrested without incident".

items.title: Teachers' strike to hit Hobart and southern government schools
items.description: Industrial action by teachers seeking better conditions means government schools in southern Tasmania, including in the Hobart area, are shut today.

items.title: Inflation cooled slightly in February before Iran war energy price spike
items.description: The latest monthly data does not capture the recent rise in energy prices caused by the war in the Middle East, which began on February 28.
